options.name: label
options.description: What is measured: visible title and the accessible name of the meter (aria-labelledby).

options.name: hideLabel
options.description: Visually hide the title; it stays the accessible name.

options.name: description
options.description: Visible text below the gauge (text only). Not referenced by aria-describedby.

options.name: value
options.description: Current value. null (or a non-finite number) shows an em dash and the value text "No value"; aria-valuenow is removed. Values outside min-max are clamped on the arc and in aria-valuenow; the value text keeps the real value.

options.name: bands
options.description: Qualitative bands { to: number, label: string, color?: 1-8 } in ascending to order; the first band starts at min. Drawn as a thin arc outside the track; the current band's label is printed under the reading and appended to the value text.

options.name: target
options.description: Target value marked across the arc; appended to the value text ("target 60%").

options.name: color
options.description: Palette slot of the value arc. Default: the current band's color (its color, else its position), else 1.

options.name: valueFormat
options.description: Number format for the reading, range ends, target, and value text.

options.name: formatValue
options.description: Custom value text; overrides valueFormat everywhere.

options.name: theme
options.description: Look and feel: { palette?: string[] (1-8 CSS colors for slots 1-8); fontFamily?; fontSize? (8-32 px); textColor?; gridLines?: boolean; gridColor?; gridDash? ("4 2" or "none"); axisColor?; lineWidth? (0.5-12 px); markerSize? (1-20 px); cornerRadius?, barRadius?, cellRadius?, sliceRadius?, boxRadius? (0-50 px); swatchRadius? (0-8 px); tooltipRadius?, controlRadius? (0-50 px); lineJoin?: 'round' | 'miter' | 'bevel'; areaOpacity? (0-1); gradient?: boolean; valueLabelColor?; tooltip?: { background?, color?, borderColor? }; legendPosition?: 'top' | 'bottom' | 'start' | 'end'; animation?: boolean | { duration?: number (0-5000 ms) } }. Applied as --aui-chart-* custom properties and classes on the host through the CSSOM (CSP-safe); colors are validated with CSS.supports('color'). Animation is opt-in and never runs with prefers-reduced-motion: reduce or [data-aui-animation='none']. The gauge uses palette, gridColor (track), fontFamily, textColor (range and band labels), and animation.

options.name: showRange
options.description: Print the formatted min and max under the ends of the arc.

options.name: direction
options.description: Accepted for configuration consistency; the gauge is not mirrored (min at the lower left, clockwise to max at the lower right).

properties.name: valueText
properties.description: The accessible value text (aria-valuetext: generated or valueText).

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Remove rendering, host classes, and the configuration subscription.

cssClasses.name: aui-gauge
cssClasses.description: Host; inline grid, 12rem wide by default (set inline-size to resize; the SVG scales through its viewBox).

cssClasses.name: aui-gauge__band / __band--c1 ... --c8
cssClasses.description: Band arcs and their palette slots (aria-hidden).

cssClasses.name: aui-gauge__reading / __band-label / __range
cssClasses.description: Center reading, current band name, and range ends (aria-hidden).
